name: Boggs v. Boggs
summary: The Supreme Court held that ERISA preempts a state law that allowed a non-participant spouse to transfer her community property interest in undistributed pension plan benefits via a testamentary transfer, finding that federal law governed the disposition of those benefits.
significance: This case directly addresses the preemptive effect of ERISA on state law claims involving the transfer of pension and retirement benefits in the context of domestic relations, making it highly relevant to how federal law limits state divorce courts.
